stories.title: North Wales Police officer awarded King’s Police Medal for football policing work
stories.summary: A North Wales Police officer who became Wales’ first female football policing officer has been awarded the King’s Police Medal. PC Heidi Goldsack received the honour for services to policing and the football community.
